facts.fact: Component 1 of the Angola Digital Acceleration Project (PADA), as set out in terms of reference of February 2026, is to fund a diagnostic of broadband gaps that identifies and prioritises the areas and public institutions, municipal administrations named among them with schools and hospitals, that have no service or limited service, to inform the design of a Broadband Connectivity Programme; the diagnostic and programme were still to be carried out.
facts.system: Programa de Conectividade de Banda Larga (PADA, Componente 1)

facts.fact: PADA, whose Component 1 would fund the Broadband Connectivity Programme through competitive tenders to private operators, is financed by a USD 300,000,000 International Bank for Reconstruction and Development loan running to March 2030, per its terms of reference of February 2026.
facts.system: Programa de Conectividade de Banda Larga (PADA, Componente 1)

facts.fact: The Instituto de Modernização Administrativa (IMA), a state body, oversees and implements PADA through a project implementation unit, per the terms of reference of February 2026; the networks themselves are to be built by private operators with catalytic funding.
facts.system: Programa de Conectividade de Banda Larga (PADA, Componente 1)
